ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 75% low-intensity (black) and 25% high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated at the distal lateral regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity contiguous blobs localized at the distal ends of both lobes. The left lobe patch is solid white with jagged proximal boundaries; the right lobe patch contains several low-intensity circular inclusions (mottling) within the high-intensity field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 105 degrees and a moderate bounding-box depth relative to the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude serrations visible along the distal thirds of the trailing edge; the medial thirds approaching the notch exhibit a smoother, continuous linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes, tapering to acute points at the lateral terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of elevated, light-brown/white circular pixel groups (barnacles) localized exclusively at the distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible; primarily three parallel diagonal lines on the right lobe and scattered horizontal scratches on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization present on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
